questions.question: The President of India has the power to pardon under which article of the Constitution of India?
questions.solution:
__
 
• The President of India has the power to pardon under **Article 72**__ of the Constitution of India.
 
• Article 63 provides that there shall be a Vice President of India.
 
• Article 86 mentions the rights of the President to address and send messages to Houses.
 
• Article 52 states that there shall be a President of India.
 
• Article 161 provides power to the Governor to pardon sentences.

questions.question: The name of the eldest son of Shah Jahan was ________.
questions.solution:
__
 
• The name of the eldest son of Shah Jahan was **Dara Shikoh**__.
 
• Shah Jahan was the 5th Mughal Emperor of the Mughal dynasty.
 
• Dara Shikoh translated the Upanishads from Sanskrit to Persian.
 
• He had 4 sons- Dara Shikoh, Aurangzeb, Murad Baksh, and Shah Shuja.
 
• In 1657, when he fell ill, a war of succession took place amongst all his sons.
 
• Aurangzeb thus ascended the throne after defeating the three of them.

questions.solution:

questions.question: The first Prime Minister of Pakistan was ________.
questions.solution:
__

• He was assassinated on 16 October 1951 by professional assassin Said Akbar who shot him twice in the chest during a political rally at Rawalpindi.

questions.question: Which of following is NOT a factor on which the resistance of a wire depends?
questions.solution:
__
 
• The resistance of a wire depends on 3 factors, which are the resistivity of the material, cross-sectional area of the wire, and length of the wire.
 
• It does not depend on the **density of the material**__.
 
• Resistance, in an electric circuit, is defined as the opposition to the flow of electric current.

questions.question: In computer parlance, what does R stand for in URL?
questions.solution:

questions.question: What does the first ‘I’ stand for in ‘INSPIRE,’ which is an outreach programme by the Department of Science and Technology for attraction of talent to Science?
questions.solution:
__
 
• INSPIRE stands for **Innovation**__ in Science Pursuit for Inspired Research.
 
• It is an outreach programme by the Department of Science and Technology for attraction of talent to Science.
 
• Its objective is to communicate the excitements of the creative pursuit of science to the youth population of India and attract talent to the study of science at an early stage.
 
• The scheme is divided into 3 programs, which are SEATS, SHE, and AORC programs. These are further divided into 5 components.

questions.question: Which among the following is the largest asteroid?
